notes: Version 11.28. Three fixes to how updates are judged, from a real field case on 11.27. First, one failed update is only ever counted once now: the watcher and the running program can no longer count the same rollback twice. Second, when an update lands and runs, its record is wiped clean on the spot - a version that stumbled once and then installed fine no longer keeps a settled label hanging over it. Third, the first seconds of startup are guarded now, so a hiccup right after an update cannot close the program before it opens. The 11.27 watcher, the rollback backoff, the single-updater lock with its per-try fingerprint, the preload fix, the readable buttons, and the repaired windows are all still here. The phone build stays at 11.9.12.
